This page lists 23 Postman keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `postman.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Postman to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t postman.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/postman.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Postman.app`; if Postman lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Navigation

Use arrow keys to navigate collections.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⌥1` | Focus Sidebar |
| `⌘⌥2` | Focus Builder |
| `⌘1-9` | Focus on #th Tab |
| `⌘⇧/` | Switch Between Tabs |
| `↓` | Move to Next Item |
| `↑` | Move to Previous Item |
| `→` | Expand Collection/Folder |
| `←` | Collapse Collection/Folder |
| `⇧↓` | Select Current AND Next Item |
| `⇧↑` | Select Current AND Previous Item |
| `⌘F` | Search Sidebar |
| `⏎` | Open Request in a Tab |

## Manipulation

Select item in sidebar first.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘C` | Copy |
| `⌘V` | Paste |
| `⌦` | Delete |
| `⌘D` | Duplicate |
| `⌘E` | Edit/Rename |

## Global

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘S` | Save |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save As |
| `⌘⏎` | Send Request |
| `⌘\` | Toggle Sidebar |
| `⌘L` | Jump to URL |
| `⌘⌥C` | Open Console |

## Template file

The full [`postman.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/postman.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
